snippet.title: Casino Resort Tower is coming to Steam Early Access!
snippet.description:
Game Description:
🎰 The city has issued its first casino licenses! Build and manage a tower from the ground up, where no two days are the same. Survive chaos from unruly guests and fussy employees, and master the jackpot casino resort simulation.
